name: vprepcaa
description: vprepcaa: VCAA exam practice platform (successor to vcaa-pixel-practice).

scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute vprepcaa-db --local --file=seeds/dev.sql && wrangler d1 execute vprepcaa-db --local --file=seeds/dev-dashboard.sql
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test:auth && npm run test:join && npm run test:dashboard && npm run test:practice
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply vprepcaa-db-preview --remote --config wrangler.preview-migrations.jsonc
